{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99)
df_filtered = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute average revenue per completed order, excluding QA orders
mean_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Confirm the number of rows
n_completed = len(df_filtered)

mean_revenue, n_completed"}
